components.name: Button
components.description: Default squishy button, sunk into the page; pink on hover, deep pink and a squash when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; color: #f5dcec; background: #120a19; border: 2px solid #6f588c; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .12s, color .12s, transform .08s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #ff79c6; color: #ff79c6; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff79c6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { background: #592a45; border-color: #ff79c6; color: #f5dcec; transform: scale(.95); }

components.name: Flat link button
components.description: Text-only action such as 'watch ›' or '‹ map'.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #f5dcec; background: none; border: 0; padding: 2px 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { color: #ff79c6; outline: none; }

components.name: Sticker card
components.description: Raised plum card with a lilac seam that lifts off the page.
components.html:
the garden path
peach cat went… somewhere…
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; background: #241634; border: 2px solid #6f588c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; color: #f5dcec; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(6,2,12,.6); max-width: 320px; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 9px 18px rgba(6,2,12,.6); } .ds-card-title { color: #ff79c6; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Speech bubble
components.html: where did everyone go… oh.. the garden path.. ♪
components.css: .ds-bubble { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #f5dcec; background: #241634; border: 2px solid #a64f81; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(6,2,12,.6); max-width: 420px; }

components.name: Pet card (legendary)
components.description: A collected pet as a sticker; outline is its rarity colour, glow on a fresh pull.
components.css: .ds-pet { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; width: 110px; background: #241634; border: 2px solid #ffc857; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px; text-align: center; color: #f5dcec; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(6,2,12,.6), 0 0 18px rgba(255,200,87,.45); } .ds-pet-art { height: 56px; margin: 4px auto; width: 56px; background: #ffb59a; border-radius: 4px; image-rendering: pixelated; } .ds-pet-name { font-size: 13px; } .ds-pet-tier { font-size: 11px; color: #ffc857; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Header tab row; the active tab uses the pressed style.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tabs button { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; color: #f5dcec; background: #120a19; border: 2px solid #6f588c; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover, .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { border-color: #ff79c6; color: #ff79c6; outline: none; } .ds-tabs button.on { background: #592a45; border-color: #ff79c6; color: #f5dcec; }

components.name: Progress bar
components.description: Pill bar for food, mood and trip progress.
components.css: .ds-bar { width: 220px; height: 10px; background: #120a19; border: 2px solid #653d80; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar-fill { width: 40%; height: 100%; background: #c9a0ff; border-radius: 5px; }

components.name: Place title
components.description: Coiny headline for a place name, with its muted note line.
components.html:
the garden path
●●○○   bag ◆27   +12 xp
components.css: .ds-place-name { font-family: 'Coiny', 'Maple Mono', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: #ff79c6; } .ds-place-note { font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #9a88ad; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-place-note span { color: #8be9fd; }

narrative.overview: Desk Pets looks like a well-loved sticker book opened under the covers at night. The page is a dark violet (in the current plum theme), and everything on it is a sticker: outlined cards that lift off the page, pixel-art pets with crisp edges, crayon doodles on the map and the trail. Collecting is the point, so things you own look like things worth keeping: each card carries its rarity as the colour of its outline, and rare things get their own glow.
keyCharacteristics: Colour themes are open (light and dark being explored); plum is the current default
Outlined, rounded sticker cards that lift off the page
Rarity lives in outline colour; glow is saved for rewards and rare pulls
Pixel-art pets with nearest-neighbour scaling, beside crayon-style doodles
Coiny for moments, Maple Mono for everything else; colours, font and icons are player settings
Lowercase, friendly copy; the pet talks in speech bubbles

rules.name: The Fixed Meaning Rule
rules.body: Cyan is coins, gold is sparkles and xp, mint is healing. Never use them decoratively; the player reads them before the words.

rules.name: The Roles Not Colours Rule
rules.body: Screens use colour roles (page, raised, deep, text, pink, lilac, coins, xp), never raw colours, so any theme, light or dark, can swap the whole palette.

rules.name: The Rarity Belongs To Pets Rule
rules.body: Tier colours only ever mean rarity; UI chrome never borrows them.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: UI and pet copy is lowercase and friendly ("say welcome back"). Numbers and names keep their own case.

rules.name: The No Dot Separator Rule
rules.body: Never join bits of text with a dot or bullet separator ("52 pets · page 1 of 3", "greedy · earns more coins"). Give each piece its own element, line or label instead, or use plain words and punctuation (a colon, a comma, "and").

rules.name: The Display Is A Moment Rule
rules.body: The display size (headline and up) never sets a paragraph or a button row; one or two uses per screen.

rules.name: The Glow Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Glows mean "something good happened here". A glow on anything routine teaches the player to ignore it.

dos: Do keep every surface on the violet ladder: Deep Night #120a19, Midnight Page #1a1024, Raised Plum #241634.
Do outline stickers with 2px borders and 8-14px corners.
Do keep colour meanings fixed: cyan coins, gold xp/sparkles, mint healing, tiers for rarity.
Do scale pixel art by whole numbers with nearest-neighbour sampling.
Do write UI copy in lowercase, short and friendly.
donts: Don't hardcode a colour in a screen; use the theme's roles so every theme works.
Don't use blur, frosted glass, gradients across panels or other effects Godot can't draw.
Don't glow routine chrome; glow is for rewards and rare pulls.
Don't show odds, percentages or anything that hints the game is dark in pet speech.
Don't set paragraphs or button rows in the display size.
Don't use a dot or bullet (·, •) as a separator between pieces of text.
